estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). One playthrough, no difficulty settings, no online trophies, free-roam after the story, no mission replay.

phases.decision: What do I do first? Play the story — and take the one thing that can be missed.
phases.entry: Start a new game. Nothing in this phase needs a second playthrough.
phases.notes: Chapter 1 teaches the game. Two side lines open here (Kenton, Cal) and the home TV games are already playable. The only time-sensitive item in the whole platinum is in this phase: Lucia's balcony meditation.
phases.title: Phase 1 — Chapter 1: Start smart
phases.watchOut: Positive Mental Attitude: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept the meditation. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends.

phases.decision: What opens up now? Duo free-roam, fences, the Key Cloner — and most of the character questlines.
phases.entry: Finish Chapter 1. Duo play, character switching and most side questlines unlock in these chapters.
phases.notes: Coffee Break (Chapter 2) unlocks playing together and switching characters — that gates the duo trophies, Personal Best and the last meditation. Chapter 3 adds Yasmani's jobs, Randy's wish list, the Key Cloner and the Dye Pack Jammer. Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel: 200 vehicles and 100 animals are needed for 100%.
phases.title: Phase 2 — Chapters 2–3: Open the map
phases.watchOut: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — 15 slots, no mission replay. Cheats stay off: they disable trophies and saving.

phases.decision: What is left of the story? Four story trophies, the finale, and the vault robberies.
phases.entry: Finish Chapter 3. The last story missions and the bank-vault jobs open here.
phases.notes: The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… teaches bank vault robberies and hands you the armoured truck trophy free. Vault jobs always draw a 4-star response, so Hot Together usually pops here on its own.
phases.title: Phase 3 — Chapters 4–5: Finish the story
phases.watchOut: Nothing here is missable. After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist opens.

phases.decision: What does 100% actually ask for? Far less than everything — about 60% of true completion.
phases.entry: Story complete. The checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
phases.notes: The checklist is lenient: most side quests are not required and most collectibles need only part of their total. You need 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the hardest ten. The only lines that want everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
phases.title: Phase 4 — After the credits: The 100% checklist
phases.watchOut: Work the checklist line by line from the Progress menu. Progress made during the story already counts.

phases.decision: What is still standing between me and the platinum? The stranger strands and the one-off feats.
phases.entry: Checklist done or nearly done. Everything left is open-world cleanup.
phases.notes: Strangers & Freaks is not part of 100%, so it may still need strands. Then the one-off feats: the tank, the plane, the bowling alley, max strength for both characters, the 500 profile actions — and the five trophies whose methods are still unconfirmed.
phases.title: Phase 5 — Cleanup: Strangers, secrets, platinum
phases.watchOut: Five trophies are still UNVERIFIED: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin. Check their guides before chasing them.

title: Road to the Platinum
